clips.title: The story
paras: Travelers climb from Dun Morogh to the Gates of Ironforge, where a stone king guards the way into the dwarven capital. The gates open in the mountain face, with High King Modimus Anvilmar's statue just inside.

The Gates of Ironforge rise above the snowy lowlands at the end of a winding, fortified ramp from central Dun Morogh. Beyond the massive portal, you enter the city proper beneath an enormous stone likeness of High King Modimus Anvilmar. He united the dwarven clans before the War of the Three Hammers. The passage opens directly into the Commons, where Ironforge's trade and banking are centered.
